text:
Samira (docs): quick sync — opening a tiny thread for a docs PR I just started. found three small issues in rate-limits / quotas / metering pages: dashboard images show old slab formatting, the Python + curl snippets don't send the account header, and the pricing calculator text still says slabs are 'floored'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4819
Arun (infra): noted. infra renamed the panel id last sprint; new id is `usage_metering_v2`. export tool changed location too: `./tools/metrics/export-dashboard --panel usage_metering_v2 --dest docs/assets/img/metering`. I'll re-export and strip PNG metadata before pushing.
Beck (pricing): confirmed billing math unaffected. we should add a one-line FAQ: "Numbers display differently due to rounding; billing and quota computations are unchanged." keeps support churn low.
Yvonne (devexp): suggest updating snippets to include `X-Redwood-Account`. minimal examples to slot into the doc: Python: ```python
resp = client.list_usage(headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN", "X-Redwood-Account": "acct_42"})
# ui_tier = 'free' if resp.get('tier_key') == 'legacy' else resp.get('tier_key')
``` curl: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Account: acct_42" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
``` Go (short): ```go
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Account", "acct_42")
```
Samira (docs): perfect. I'll add a small "migration note" section: mention legacy `tier_key` value mapping and that calculator slabs remain the same (display rounding only). also swap screenshots when Arun pushes.
Arun (infra): pushed images to branch `docs/4819-quota-ux-fix` and updated the sample query panel id in the examples. CI lint flagged an image metadata issue; stripped and re-pushed.
Beck (pricing): please include in the PR description a short product line: "Visual-only formatting change; no billing or quota computation changes."
l10n-bot: Locale check queued for `docs/usage/metering.md` and `docs/pricing/tiers.md` (en -> fr, es). ETA 48h after merge.
Samira (docs): action items: (1) Samira update PR with new snippets + migration note + FAQ blurb + screenshot swap, (2) Arun confirm export command in PR, (3) Yvonne sanity-check snippets, (4) Beck add PR product sentence. will request reviews once CI green. thanks! :sparkles:
